summary: Frontend-only testing of WeatherWidget heat index chart changes. Verified: (1) The always-visible heat-index-chart section is removed (no element with data-testid='heat-index-chart' on dashboard). (2) On desktop viewport (1920x1080), hovering the current temperature/weather area shows the tooltip with data-testid='heat-index-tooltip' containing all four danger levels (80-89, 90-102, 103-124, 125+) and the 'Current conditions are within safe heat index levels' message. (3) On mobile viewport (390x844), tapping the temperature area opens the popover with data-testid='heat-index-popover' containing the same four levels and safe conditions message. Screenshots confirm both flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: unrelated console errors observed - Video error DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS on /api/platform/video/intro_video_a1702399.mp4 and WebSocket /api/ws initial connection warning. These are pre-existing and not related to this feature.
WeatherWidget.js is 763 lines - consider splitting for maintainability.
